purpose: School identity, feature/settings, organisation codes and small policies.
rules: Keep runtime/session machinery outside this functional table count.

key_columns: user_id; school_id; external_id; name; contact; status; row_version
rules: User kind/job title is not authority.

key_columns: role_id; school_id; code; name; allowed_actions_json; denied_actions_json; status; row_version
rules: Four initial roles are only optional seed rows, not a new permission mechanism. Role changes use logs and explicit assignment policy.

purpose: Dated roles, class/group/position membership and activity people.
key_columns: assignment_id; assignment_kind; school_id; user_id; role_id; role_log_id; scope_type/id; period_id; assigned_by; effective_from/until; deassigned_by/at; activity_id; planned_status; attendance_status; relationship; status
rules: Separate row kinds distinguish role grant, descriptive position, class member, participant and activity staff. Role assignment pins role definition/log; membership expiry is independent of late-response policy.

purpose: Years, periods and scheduled assessment points.
key_columns: period_id; school_id; kind; parent_year_id; start_at; end_at; assessment_at; sequence; summer; status
rules: A schedule point is not a reporting period. Report windows explicitly select period IDs.

purpose: Activity root and optional child assessment stages.
key_columns: record_id; kind; parent_activity_id; owner_id; title; description; start_at; end_at; actual_end_at; period_id; stage_type; evidence_window; opens_at; due_at; closes_at; questionnaire_template_id; labels_json; reviewer_id; review_status; operational_status; row_version; approved_log_id
rules: One table, separate root/stage rows. Stage has stable identity; pending changes cannot overwrite the effective approved schedule. Teacher/TA roster responsibility stays in assignments.

purpose: Question content, source, ability, labels and default section.
key_columns: question_id; source_instrument/version; source_reference; wording_en/zh; answer_type; spectrum_id; spectrum_log_id; default_section_id/name; ability_code/name/description; labels_json; negative_wording; status; row_version
rules: Section metadata can be inline. Context-specific section/order overrides go in questionnaire manifest. Question labels do not create assessment mappings.

key_columns: spectrum_id; code; name; kind; min/max; options_json; scoring_rule_json; status; row_version
rules: Agreement/frequency scales are rows. Option entries contain stable keys, order, bilingual labels and optional numeric values. Missing remains distinct from zero; scale changes require pinned snapshots.

purpose: Template packages and assigned student/teacher/peer tasks with answers.
key_columns: questionnaire_id; record_kind; template_id; template_log_id; activity_id; stage_id; activity_log_id; stage_log_id; assign_to; subject_student_id; assign_by; reviewer_id; perspective; question_manifest_json; answers_json; opens_at; due_at; submitted_at; due_at_submission; review_status; processing_status; visibility_status; row_version; submitted_log_id; approved_log_id
rules: record_kind = template | response. A template row is the reusable ordered package; response rows reference its released snapshot and freeze their exact question manifest. Responses remain one row across review states. Type-specific constraints forbid mixing template data with student answers.

key_columns: catalogue_id; version; label_capable; assessment_capable; axes_json; levels_json; labels_json; groups_json; status; row_version; approved_log_id
rules: Independently activate label and assessment slots. Small root count does not remove exact definition-version pinning.

purpose: Canonical axis-step descriptions and evidence conditions.
key_columns: step_id; catalogue_id; catalogue_log_id; axis_code; level_code; descriptor_en/zh; conditions_json; score_band; source_reference; status
rules: Immutable step rows belong to a particular catalogue snapshot. Shared levels and conditions retain different meanings even though nested physically.

purpose: Source/derivative files, face/segment state and reviewed labels.
key_columns: media_id; parent_media_id; title; human_caption; source; private_reference; media_type; hash; uploader; captured_at; scan_status; active_scan_work_id; labels_json; segments_json; reviewed_by/at; student_visibility; staff_scope_json; assessment_eligible; consent_status; row_version; confirmed_labels_log_id
rules: Face region/segment objects need stable IDs, geometry/timestamps and per-item identity/decision state. Raw per-run candidates remain in work_items.output_json. A scan finishing is not human confirmation. One file can link to many students.

purpose: Accepted evidence plus typed certificate/mark/manual-feedback fields.
key_columns: proof_id; student_id; activity_id; stage_id; source_type/id/log_id/item_key; proof_kind; perspective; authorship_origin; summary; issuer; achievement_grade/result; subject; exam; mark; grading_scheme; reviewer_id; review_status; visibility_status; row_version
rules: Source-backed proof refers to original immutable answer/media content. Certificate difficulty, academic mark and rubric step use different fields. Draft inputs appear in Proof List only after acceptance.

key_columns: assessment_id; kind; student_id; activity_id; stage_id; catalogue_id/log_id; axis_code; level; consistency; selected_periods_json; method; policy_ref; calculation_trace_json; inherited_result_id; reviewer_id; review_status; publication_status; row_version; approved_log_id; published_log_id
rules: One review pattern, separate activity-observation/result kinds. AI remains suggestion output, not a human observation. Exact included/excluded sources and approvals remain traceable.

purpose: Working content, six learner fields and official snapshot reference.
key_columns: portfolio_id; student_id; selected_periods_json; template_ref; introduction; academic_strengths; academic_development_needs; nonacademic_strengths; nonacademic_development_needs; next_steps; motivation; sections_json; field_provenance_json; reviewer_id; publisher_id; review_status; publication_status; row_version; submitted_log_id; published_log_id
rules: Same Portfolio row moves through draft/submitted/approved. Official output resolves immutable published_log_id while current working content may be edited. Generated/student/teacher/final text snapshots remain recoverable.

purpose: Many-to-many source links, selected uses and dependency graph.
key_columns: link_id; school_id; relation; source_type/id/log_id/item_key; target_type/id/log_id/item_key; student_id; order; inclusion_state; visibility; assessment_eligible; actor/time/reason; status
rules: Typed allowed relations plus server endpoint/school checks. Needed for media to multiple students and source invalidation to multiple reports; not an all-purpose attribute store.

purpose: Imports/rows, scan/AI runs, image/correction requests and exports.
key_columns: work_id; kind; parent_work_id; target_id; actor_id; assignee_id; created_at; due_at; completed_at; status; original_input_json; output_json; provider/model/prompt; attempt; error; expected_version; resulting_id
rules: Ordinary submission approval stays on its domain row; do not create a duplicate approval work item for every response. Use work_items only for independently actionable or asynchronous work and exceptions. Each provider/run and each import row remains individually identifiable.

purpose: Shared immutable before/after, content snapshots and decisions.
key_columns: log_id; school_id; entity_type/id; row_version; event; from_status; to_status; actor_id; role_assignment_id; reason; recorded_at; effective_at; content_schema_version; snapshot_json; before_json; after_json; derived_from_log_id
rules: Every accepted mutation and log write is atomic. Submitted/approved/published snapshots store full content and exact referenced versions; a status-only log cannot reproduce a decision.
